title: Profile & settings
description: Your account, app settings (biometric, dark mode, accessibility), help, and logout.

screens.name: Profile
screens.note: The live page 1:1 (scrolls: account, app settings, help, Logout). From the profile icon on Stocks home.

screens.name: Settings
screens.note: Three setting cards: Biometric, Theme (Light / Dark / Auto, live), Accessibility (off).

screens.name: Settings · accessibility on
screens.note: Accessibility on: darker colours (♿ Accessible theme) and a bigger font together; the illustration shows it.

screens.note: A/B version B (Zomato-style): Appearance shows the current theme; tapping it opens the Appearance sheet.

screens.note: Light theme / Dark theme / Use device theme as radio rows; Save preference applies it.
